##### Project general facts

Oasis Towers by GJ Properties is a striking twin-tower residential development, whose architecture reflects a modern high-rise design with clean lines and balanced proportions, creating a strong and elegant presence within the skyline. The project offers a selection of spacious studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, all designed to maximise comfort, privacy, and natural light through floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning views of the sea and surrounding city.

The development offers a well-connected and vibrant lifestyle with a wide range of amenities and conveniences located within minutes of the community. Residents benefit from easy access to hypermarkets, supermarkets, cafes, restaurants, hospitals, sports facilities, parks, and leisure destinations including Ajman Beach and Marina. Its prime location near Al Ittihad Street ensures excellent connectivity to Sharjah and Dubai, making daily commuting and city access smooth and efficient while maintaining a relaxed coastal living environment.

Inside, Oasis Towers features stylish contemporary interiors finished with high-quality materials and elegant detailing. The apartments are designed with neutral colour palettes and functional layouts that enhance space, light, and comfort throughout. Kitchens are fully fitted, offering practicality and convenience for everyday use. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their homes while enjoying a refined foundation of modern finishes and thoughtful design.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
